name: The Comeback
description: For Valerie Cherish, no price is too high to pay for clinging to the spotlight. Desperate to revive her career, she agrees to star in a reality TV series, allowing cameras to follow her every move as she lands a part on a new network sitcom.

videos.title: Valerie Backstage at Dancing with the Stars
Pilot
videos.overview: Actress Valerie Cherish agrees to be filmed for a reality show in an effort to get a part in a new sitcom.

videos.title: Valerie Triumphs at the Upfronts
videos.overview: Valerie, Mickey and the cast of 'Room and Bored' are introduced to the media.

videos.title: Valerie Bonds with the Cast
videos.overview: After a table read for 'the first official episode,' Valerie invites her co-stars to a 'bonding lunch.'

videos.title: Valerie Stands Up for Aunt Sassy
videos.overview: Valerie enlists a new writer, Gigi, to help pitch a less offensive line for her character.

videos.title: Valerie Demands Dignity
videos.overview: The network tries to spice up Valerie's reality show by bringing in the star of another reality show.

videos.title: Valerie Saves the Show
videos.overview: With the cast in a funk, Valerie tries to boost morale with a late-night cookie delivery.

videos.title: Valerie Gets a Very Special Episode
videos.overview: Valerie gets a 'name' actor for a 'Room and Bored' episode about her character.

videos.title: Valerie Relaxes in Palm Springs
videos.overview: Valerie and Mark head for a long weekend at a Palm Springs resort--with strings attached.

videos.title: Valerie Hangs with the Cool Kids
videos.overview: At the network's insistence, 'Room and Bored' gets a makeover and two new cast members.

videos.title: Valerie Gets a Magazine Cover
videos.overview: With Juna getting all the hype, Valerie enlists a new publicist to land a magazine cover.

videos.title: Valerie Stands Out on the Red Carpet
videos.overview: Valerie gets a new dress and a new look after 'Room and Bored'--and Juna--earn nominations for a familiar TV-awards show.

videos.title: Valerie Shines Under Stress
videos.overview: Jane pulls rank on Tom and Paulie G to get Valerie more lines on 'Room and Bored.'

videos.title: Valerie Does Another Classic Leno
videos.overview: Valerie makes a memorable guest appearance on 'The Tonight Show.'

videos.title: Valerie Makes a Pilot
videos.overview: Valerie learns that her old nemesis Paulie G. is creating a character based on her for a new HBO series.

videos.title: Valerie Tries to Get Yesterday Back
videos.overview: HBO tasks Valerie to bring back Jane to produce a behind-the-scenes documentary.

videos.title: Valerie Is Brought to Her Knees
videos.overview: Valerie meets her co-star, and becomes increasingly anxious about shooting an intimate scene.

videos.title: Valerie Saves the Show
videos.overview: Valerie learns that some of her 'Seeing Red' scenes may be cut, and takes an improv class at The Groundlings.

videos.title: Valerie Is Taken Seriously
videos.overview: Valerie frets about Paulie G.'s agitated behavior, and scores an exclusive interview with The New York Times.

videos.title: Valerie Cooks in the Desert
videos.overview: Valerie's plans for a special date night with Mark are thwarted by a day-long desert reshoot.

videos.title: Valerie Faces the Critics
videos.overview: While Valerie and her team ramp up for the Emmys(R), Valerie's marriage is put to the test by the film crew.

videos.title: Valerie Gets What She Really Wants
videos.overview: Valerie gets her first real taste of success, and wonders if Mark will be there on the biggest night of her life.

videos.title: Valerie Gets a New Chapter
videos.overview: Valerie is offered a role in a new multi-cam sitcom – but is hesitant to accept when she learns it will be written by AI.

videos.title: Valerie Has a Secret
videos.overview: Valerie meets her human showrunners and tries to convince a TV vet to direct the pilot.

videos.title: Valerie Faces Reality
videos.overview: Valerie discovers that being back on a soundstage makes her miss her old sitcom team of one: Mickey – whose death she never processed.

videos.title: Valerie Does It All
videos.overview: When AI churns out an unusable script, Valerie is forced to lean into her executive producer role to do damage control.

videos.title: Valerie Lights a Candle
videos.overview: Faced with a new and unqualified showrunner, Valerie does everything she can to save the day and keep her show afloat – even if it means making a deal with a very familiar devil from her showbiz past...all to Jane's disapproval.

videos.title: Valerie's Home Alone
videos.overview: As Mark heads off to Burning Man, Valerie finds herself alone amid a media meltdown after news of her AI written show is somehow leaked to the public. Later, Val is further shocked to discover that a member of her team has not signed the studio's NDA.

videos.title: Valerie Chases the Truth
videos.overview: Valerie tries to repair the damage caused by negative AI press – and save Mark's reality show job by making an appearance on Finance Dudes.

videos.title: Valerie Cherish
videos.overview: Urged by NuNet to make a public statement in defense of AI, Valerie contemplates her future...with or without How's That?!

awards: Nominated for 4 Primetime Emmys. 3 wins & 23 nominations total
